crossRefs.note: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child…
A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on Yahweh’s name.
Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him…
All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.
the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.
the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
